payload.summary: In a 2,000-case stable coupled-loop proxy, flattening multirate periods changed 2000/2000 endpoints and reversing explicit sequential order changed 2000/2000, while snapshot-atomic declaration permutation changed 0/2000 endpoints/hashes. A schedule-blind hash collapsed four behaviorally distinct variants to one identity; schedule-aware hashing yielded four.
payload.recommended_action: Do not add FRANK-specific loop syntax. Preserve behavior-changing clock/timescale/commit/order/halting dimensions in typed canonical IR and semantic identity; canonicalize order away only under a typed same-epoch snapshot/set contract. Freeze these semantics in H1 and differential-test H2.
